name: us4-port-selection
description: 003 T043 [US4] — The two ports are interchangeable for the same input state (FR-013, Constitution VI). The install places no machine-wide executable, so the assistant selects the entry point from the host: `.specify/extensions/jira/scripts/bash/spec-kit-jira.sh` on macOS and Linux, `.specify/extensions/jira/scripts/powershell/spec-kit-jira.ps1` on Windows. That only helps if the two produce the same outcome, which is what this scenario pins: over one fixture carrying the registry exactly as `specify extension add` writes it, both ports must report the same registered entries in the same hook_health object, reach the same bridge outcome, and leave a byte-identical repository tree — the registry included, since neither port may write it (FR-022). The harness runs the scenario through each port's own entry point, so the port selection the command documents describe is exercised rather than assumed.
